name: GaryWear Active Brief, X-Large, Black
description: The GaryWear Active Brief is a fabric pant worn over an absorbent product and designed for an extra layer of protection. It is for active people of all ages with medium to heavy incontinence. Unlike traditional protective garments, Active Briefs feature a slimmer cut that makes them less bulky and more discreet. They are made from PUL (polyurethane laminated polyester) a breathable, waterproof fabric. Covered-in sturdy elastic and a contoured thigh cut helps prevent leaks. Higher back keeps you extra dry at night. Measure thigh, waist and hips to find best fitting size. Note: The thigh dimension is the most important for preventing leaks. These items are NOT RETURNABLE once opened due to sanitary reasons. Made in USA with USA and Imported Components. This item is non-returnable once opened due to sanitary reasons.
